blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Fails to render entirely — 'Error: cssVar is not defined' leaves a blank page with only an error message, no visualization content visible.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Encoding design is structurally honest (scaleSqrt for all bubble radii, zero-baseline bar chart, data-driven domains via d3.extent/d3.max), but the visualization fails to render entirely due to cssVar being called without definition, preventing any visual integrity from being verified.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag coalescing, pointer events, and no feedback loops are all correctly implemented, but a missing `cssVar` helper crashes the canvas draw on load, and the absence of a resize handler leaves all closed-over scales permanently stale after any window resize.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: Four crossfilter-linked panels with a restrained single-accent palette is cognitively manageable, but the 60-node co-occurrence network with unverified edge density is a density risk, and a runtime error (cssVar is not defined) prevents rendering so actual perceptual quality cannot be confirmed.
